title: 55 Token Package To Claw Your Way to Victory
includes: 55 tokens to access different variation of claw games and a step game
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Step into Lucky Puppy Arcade, Las Vegas’s most colorful claw-machine wonderland! Feel the thrill as you test your skill on rows of dazzling, Japanese-style claw machines packed with adorable plushies, rare collectibles, and kawaii surprises. Win as many prizes as you can — or trade them in for exclusive upgrades and mega rewards!
